gloss: to become complicated; to get tangled

definitions.gloss: to become complicated; to get tangled; to take a turn for the worse
definitions.explanation: For a situation, relationship, or illness to become more complicated or difficult to resolve than before.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}が{拗|こじ}れて、{解決|かいけつ}が{難|むずか}しくなった。
examples.english: The matter got complicated and became difficult to resolve.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}が{拗|こじ}れて{肺炎|はいえん}になった。
examples.english: My cold got worse and turned into pneumonia.

examples.japanese: {人間関係|にんげんかんけい}が{拗|こじ}れると{修復|しゅうふく}が{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: When human relationships get tangled, it's hard to repair them.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}). The transitive form is {拗|こじ}らせる (to complicate something).

USAGE:
{拗|こじ}れる is used for situations that were manageable but have deteriorated into something more problematic. Common contexts include:
・{話|はなし}が{拗|こじ}れる - a discussion/matter gets complicated
・{風邪|かぜ}が{拗|こじ}れる - a cold gets worse/complicated
・{関係|かんけい}が{拗|こじ}れる - a relationship becomes strained

KANJI NOTE:
The kanji {拗|こじ} is relatively uncommon; this word is often written in hiragana as こじれる.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{揉|も}める - to have trouble/conflict (more about dispute than complication)
・{悪化|あっか}する - to worsen (more general deterioration)

REGISTER:
Neutral. Used in everyday conversation.
